hook: TGSRTC plans *2,800* e-buses to replace diesel inside ORR
hook_b: TGSRTC plans *2,800* e-buses to replace diesel inside ORR
tldr: TGSRTC plans to induct around 2,800 electric buses in phases to replace diesel buses running within Outer Ring Road limits.

beats.what: The plan includes 2,200 extra e-buses under the Centre's PM E-DRIVE scheme plus retrofitting 240 diesel buses at the Uppal workshop.
beats.why: Running costs: about ₹20 per km for diesel buses against ₹8 per km for electric, per previously reported figures.
beats.care: Electrification could cut 1.6 to 2 lakh tonnes of tailpipe CO2 a year and remove NOx and particulate emissions on busy roads.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: TGSRTC estimates about ₹392 crore for charging, depot upgrades and high-tension power connections.
